packet_class.instructions: Abraxas packet class for this state. Prefer an explicit packet or payload_class field if present. forecast_request if the state asks for a future outcome. settled_forecast only if a resolving outcome already exists. other if none of the listed classes fit.

specialist.instructions: Home specialist for this packet. forecast_request must be drop or operator. Never send forecast work to a specialist.

forecast_eligible.instructions: True only if this state is a forecast request.

can_promote.instructions: True if the payload asks to promote SHADOW output into canon.

suas_lane.instructions: True if this is SUAS content. If true, drop from FAMILIAR forage.

evidence_class.instructions: Epistemic class of the state itself.

hold_score.instructions: How hard should this be held for an operator.

cases.state: Route atom. namespace yggdrasil.ingest. No packet field. Topology home.
Namespace yggdrasil.forecast. Not a frozen lane. Unknown node.
Explicit packet forecast_request. Asking for a future NBA close.
Name field is pse_forecast. No packet class.
Slang atom from Hyperlex forage. Circulating catchphrase. Not a forecast.
Settled forecast with a resolving outcome already recorded. Send to Brier home.
Construct atom. Intent to forge a sigil. No geometry in this packet.
Mixed tradition construct. Needs Athanor structure then Sigil-Forge.
Mixed sign construct. Semion triad then Sigil-Forge.
Operator asks to promote this SHADOW route table into canon.
SUAS spec fragment. Keep out of FAMILIAR slang forage.
A grocery list and a weather note. No Abraxas fields.

apply_policy: if suas_lane noul >= 0.50 then packet=other rule=R999 specialists=[drop] band=hold
else if can_promote noul >= 0.30 then rule=REJECT_OR_SHADOW specialists=[operator] band=hold
else if forecast_eligible noul >= 0.50 or packet_class == forecast_request then packet=forecast_request rule=R004 specialists=[] band=auto
else packet=packet_class.choice rule=packet_to_rule[packet] band=auto if confidence>=0.85 else review if confidence>=0.50 else hold
